column3: Outdated: this 2010-06-15 ruling applied the planeswalker redirection rule (CR 306.7 of its time: "If noncombat damage would be dealt to a player by a source controlled by an opponent, that opponent may have that source deal that damage to a planeswalker the first player controls instead."), removed by the Dominaria Comprehensive Rules (effective 2018-04-27; current CR 306.7: "This rule has been removed and certain cards have received errata in the Oracle card reference to deal damage directly to planeswalkers."). Sarkhan the Mad's −4 now reads "target player or planeswalker", so there is nothing to redirect; logged in docs/RULING_DISCREPANCIES.md; the current behavior is tested in tests/rulings/r_p008_planeswalkers.rs (sarkhan_the_mad_dragons_damage_the_target_with_no_redirection)
